titles.title: No. 35 Special

description: An arrangement of dark, reddish black leaves surrounds two white and yellow daisy-like flowers. The composition is punctuated by a few bright green leaves and stems. A plain white background contrasts with the detailed, colorfully painted plants.
title: Special No. 35
